operations.chronology_time: actual midpoint of first and last segment timestamps in each map
operations.global_association: Spearman rank correlation across 32 map medians
operations.same_speed_time_association: Spearman rank correlation across eight map medians at each speed
operations.palindrome_history: exact later minus earlier map-median difference for each same-speed symmetric pair
operations.palindrome_speed: arithmetic mean of each same-speed early/late pair, then Spearman rank across four speeds within a block
operations.distance_resolved_input: median of 64 per-curve dynamic-baseline-corrected 5 nm bins within each map
operations.p_values: not reported because maps are sequential correlated observations, not randomized independent trials

interpretation_boundary: rank associations and exact paired differences are descriptive; they do not identify speed or time causally
